_about: Ground-truth labels for GreenPath's deterministic safety surfaces. Labels are the same ones pinned by the passing test suite (tests/test_handoff.py, tests/test_api.py), repackaged as a measurable accuracy metric. The eval calls NO LLM, so the score is identical on every run.
